scope: Final PERI0 HS source, DT fragment and build-time semantic DT allowlist; interpretation of primary-agent read-only gate evidence.

facts: SMHC3 mux1 selects PERI0_800M; mux3 selects PERI1_800M
PERI0 PAT0 bit31 enables SDM pattern; PAT1 bit27 enables SDM, bit26 indicates busy

manual.conflict: The PDF marks PERI CTRL bits24:23 reserved; exact sun60iw2 platform generated header defines FREF_SEL24. Source conservatively requires REFPLL selection and never writes the selector.

parent.ref: Ready bits31/28/27 and exact u64 cross-product prove 24 MHz from observed 26 MHz board reference.
parent.peri0: Ready bits31/28/26; FREF_SEL24=1; PAT0.31=0; PAT1.27/26=0; exact rational output1=800 MHz.

accepted_static_checks.mapping: REF exact base0x02002000 size>=4; PERI0 exact base0x020020a0 size>=16. Reads CTRL+0, PAT0+8 and PAT1+12 only; LOCK+4 not read.
accepted_static_checks.clock_plan: Linear M,N each1..32; mux0 for <=12 MHz enumeration, mux1 for HS above12 MHz; u64 rational inequality prevents target overspeed before integer card_hz flooring.
accepted_static_checks.hs_cap: 25 MHz default; only boot-time read-only parameter values25/50 MHz accepted; only MMC_HIGHSPEED advertised, no DDR/HS200/HS400.
accepted_static_checks.timing: Disable/update card clock before module or phase changes. Module gated for divider/phase changes. Readbacks precede module enable, then card-clock update. SDR CTRL10=0, CLKDIV0; HS NTSR31/0=0, EDSD31=0 preservingbit0, CSDC low4=3, DRV16=1/17=0, SAMP7=1 delay0 at<=25MHz or32 above25MHz, DS7=1 delay0. Other bits are preserved by masks.
accepted_static_checks.voltage: Callback accepts fixed1.8 V only; no CMD11, regulator or pad voltage writes.

dma_unchanged.method: Exact source substring comparison from t736_dma_stop through the request worker section before mmc_host_ops

accepted_static_checks.builder: Isolated v21 source/output cloned from v19 source and v20 HRT output. Frozen v20 file hashes and v19 source hash checked before/after build; config difference limited to LOCALVERSION; actual-C clock test invoked. This review inspects builder logic and does not claim the pending build completed.

dt_allowlist.scope: Only /mmc@4023000 reg, clocks, clock-names differ; equality compares every property of every node, including additions/deletions.
dt_allowlist.reg: Append only REF0x02002000/4 and PERI00x020020a0/16 to old resources.

downstream_gate_evidence.gate_en: 0x8fff0fff: bit26=1 software gate enabled; bit10=1 No-Auto.
downstream_gate_evidence.bit10_caution: Despite AUTO_GATE_EN name, manual defines0=Auto and1=No-Auto. Zero alone is not proof of a stopped clock.
downstream_gate_evidence.candidate_scope: Candidate neither maps nor reads/writes0x02003908/0x02003988. This board evidence supports use of existing parent without shared gate writes; it is not continuous driver enforcement.

limits: Register snapshots are three stable sequential read passes, not an atomic snapshot or physical frequency measurement.
HS25/50 MHz board boot, integrity, performance and GPU coexistence acceptance remain pending primary-agent results.
No installer or package artifact execution is certified by this source review.
No shared clock writes are proposed. Preserve accepted fallback until candidate runtime acceptance.
